class_guess: Two coupled binary counters: drifting-defect digit counter (right) + edge bit counter (left)
summary: Period-5 tape; a binary counter of drifting 3-cell digits feeds a left-edge bit counter that absorbs them
mechanism: Period-5 tape 10110. Right counter: little-endian digits 110=1 / 100=0 in the stripes; each sweep adds 1 with carry.
A carried digit moves 5 cells left (digit k drifts 1 block per 2^k sweeps); overflow adds two 0-digits at the right end.
Left counter: big-endian bits 10=1 / 00=0, +1 per 2 sweeps; absorbing the lowest digit halves it (phases X/Y follow).

rules.name: R4 carry through j ones
rules.cases: j>=1, a>=1, b_i>=0 (carried digits shift one block left)

rules.name: R5 right overflow
rules.cases: j>=0, a>=1 (all digits 1: reset + two new 0-digits)

rules.name: R6 hub macro (X and Y)
rules.cases: g>=2; inc = R3/R4/R5 (g drops by 1); W+1 widens by one bit on overflow, left edge -2

rules.name: R7 absorption, phase X
rules.to: phase X if D_1=110 else Y; left bits W+1+w(1-d); right = inc^(2+(d xor w)) of (10110)^(G_1+2) R'
rules.cases: 4 cases (d,w) in {0,1}^2, 30/30 each; w = low bit of W, d = 1 iff D_1=110

rules.name: R8 hub macro, separator regime
rules.cases: s in {0, 110}; W2 non-empty and not all ones; both σ (entry/exit of this regime still open)

template.diff: 10 of 12 transitions differ (A1 B0 C0 C1 D0 D1 E0 E1 F0 F1); CounterClass1 TM1: 9; BECv7 TMs: 11-12
template.note: Different mechanism (unary blocks at the 0^inf edge); its S1/Inc1 shape fails 0/5 here (3 halt). Only BECv7's digit-list layout (Inductive RD + bin_inc) carries over.

strategy: Encode the hub as (phase, W, separator, W2, g, digit list with gaps) using BECv7-style Inductive lists. Prove R1-R5 with es/ind, R6-R8 and absorption with follow/mid, init to the first hub, then nonhalt via multistep_nonhalt + progress_nonhalt_cond on a well-formed-hub invariant. Missing first: Y-phase absorption and separator entry/exit rules.
risks: Separator regime (left part 10 W1 0|110 W2 ..., about 40% of hubs) is entered after Y-phase absorption; its entry/exit rules are not found yet.
The invariant must show g>=2 after every absorption and that digit gaps never collide (a spacing lemma on G_i).
Likely a 30-60 KB proof; the trio is correlated, so a stall here also stalls #21 and #22.
